scholarships.description: This scholarship programme offers the opportunity to continue academic education in Germany with a postgraduate course of study. It is intended for graduates who have completed their first degree (e.g., Bachelor’s or Diplom). The programme provides funding for a whole postgraduate or Master's degree programme at a state or state-recognised university in Germany, or one year of study in Germany as part of a Master's degree completed at a home university.

scholarships.title: Research Grants in Germany

scholarships.title: Study Visits for Academics - Artists and Architects
scholarships.description: The aim of this programme is to promote artistic cooperations with German host institutions for university teachers in the fields of architecture, fine arts, film, design, performing arts, and music.

scholarships.title: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
scholarships.description: DAAD scholarships for graduates with a first academic degree wishing to continue their academic training in Germany with a postgraduate course of study.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are prestigious international masters, jointly designed and delivered by a group of higher education institutions. scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are high-level and integrated study programmes at the master level, designed and delivered by an international partnership of higher education institutions. scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees in the UK. The scholarship is fully-funded, allowing scholars to focus on achieving their professional goals, networking, and experiencing UK culture.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are the UK government’s global scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations. The programme offers the opportunity to study in the UK to build knowledge, skills, and networks.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships allow exceptional individuals to study for a one-year master’s degree at a UK university. The programme is aimed at emerging leaders who possess ambition, leadership qualities, and a passion for influencing positive change in their home countries.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship
scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are the UK government’s global scholarship programme, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) and partner organisations, offering awards for individuals to study for a master's degree in the UK.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship

scholarships.description: Chevening Scholarships are UK government-funded awards for students to pursue full-time taught master's degrees in the UK. Applicants must select three eligible master's courses at UK universities.

scholarships.title: Chevening Fellowships
scholarships.description: Chevening Fellowships are offered to mid-career professionals who have reached a position of influence and want to increase their knowledge, networks, and potential through tailored short courses, research, or professional placements at UK institutions.

scholarships.title: Chevening Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies Fellowships (OCIS)
scholarships.description: These fellowships enable mid-career academics or professionals to undertake a period of self-directed research focusing on the culture and civilisation of Islam and contemporary Muslim societies in a global context. scholarships.title: Chevening Fellowships

scholarships.title: Chevening SIDS Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Chevening / Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO)

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
scholarships.description: The ASEAN Chevening Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships are for candidates from eligible lower and upper middle income Commonwealth countries, to undertake full-time taught Master’s study at a UK university. Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO).

scholarships.title: Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Master’s Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals from low and middle income Commonwealth countries to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. Candidates are nominated for this award through a nominating agency.

scholarships.title: CSC Research Impact Awards
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK

scholarships.description: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships are for applicants from least developed countries and vulnerable states for full-time doctoral study at a UK university, contributing to development needs and research impact.

scholarships.description: The Swedish Institute (SI) offers fully funded scholarships for master's level studies in Sweden. The program includes 'Global Professionals' for those aiming to advance sustainable growth and societal change, and 'Pioneering Women in STEM' to empower women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. Scholarship holders join the SI Network for Global Professionals (NFGP).

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: A fully funded scholarship for professionals who want to advance sustainable growth and drive societal change in their home country, available for master's level studies in Sweden.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is aimed at professionals with work and leadership experience, focusing on strengthening their capacity and competence to contribute to the sustainable development of their home countries.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals offers fully-funded academic scholarships for master’s studies in Sweden for professionals with work and leadership experience who have the ambition to contribute to change in their home country and region.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded academic scholarship for master's studies in Sweden, covering both tuition fees and living costs.

scholarships.title: Pioneering Women in STEM
scholarships.description: The Pioneering Women in STEM scholarship supports female citizens of specific countries in Africa and Asia to pursue full-time, one- or two-year master’s studies in STEM fields at Swedish universities. The scholarship covers full tuition fees, a monthly living allowance of SEK 12,000, and a one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000.

scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: A fully-funded scholarship for master's studies in Sweden for global professionals from eligible countries. It includes full tuition coverage, a monthly allowance of SEK 12,000, and a travel grant. Recipients also gain access to the SI Network for Global Professionals.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract the best international students for master's and doctoral programs.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
scholarships.description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their masters and PhD programs. It targets future foreign decision-makers of the private and public sectors, in priority areas of study, for applicants up to 29 years old at the master’s level and up to 35 years old at the PhD level.

fields: Human, animal and ecosystem health (One Health)
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) 2025 Visiting Fellowship Program for early career researchers is an initiative to support researchers holding a doctoral degree for less than 5 years who wish to carry out research in France in the fields of Earth systems, climate change, energy transition, environmental societal challenges, or One Health approaches.

scholarships.title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) programme supports high-calibre international students who wish to study at master's, postgraduate diploma, or PhD levels in Ireland. The scholarship includes a €10,000 stipend and a full fee waiver from the host institution.

scholarships.title: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) Grant
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) is Ireland’s single national awarding authority for all higher and further education grants. Support is available to all types of students, from school leavers to mature students, for approved full-time third-level education in Ireland and, in some cases, outside of Ireland.

scholarships.title: Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD) assists higher education institutions in providing necessary assistance and equipment to enable students with disabilities to access, participate in, and complete their course of study. Funding is allocated directly to the college to provide supports such as assistive technology, non-medical helpers, academic/learning support, and transport support.

scholarships.title: Student Assistance Fund
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Student Assistance Fund provides financial support to full or part-time students who are experiencing financial difficulties while attending college. It is designed to provide a source of financial support in addition to a SUSI grant to help with costs such as books, class materials, rent, utility bills, food, travel, childcare, and medical costs.

scholarships.title: Back to Education Allowance
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Back to Education Allowance (BTEA) allows people who are unemployed, parenting alone, or have a disability and are receiving certain payments from the Department of Social Protection to take part in second- or third-level education courses while continuing to receive support.

scholarships.title: Free Fees Initiative
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Free Fees Initiative provides funding for tuition fees for eligible full-time undergraduate students undertaking approved courses in participating higher education institutions in Ireland. Students must meet specific nationality and residency requirements (ordinarily resident in an EU/EEA/Swiss State/UK for at least three of the five years preceding entry). Note that eligible students are still required to pay a student contribution charge.

scholarships.title: Postgraduate student funding (SUSI)
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Authority / SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) funding is available for students to pursue postgraduate courses in approved institutions. The page also references tax relief available on postgraduate tuition fees.
